purpose: Source oracle for the independent monitor tests, not a fabrication or charging approval
research: hyperresearch search returned no local vault; existing retained TI PDFs and bounded official TI software guide used; no external API keys

trm_text_checks.fact: VcellMode is ONE byte, not software guide's erroneous H2 summary
2S uses bottom Cell1 and physical Cell5
trm_text_checks.regex: 2 = Two actual cells are in use \(VC5-VC4A, VC1-VC0\)
not measured correctly if the lower cell voltage drops below 2 V, because then VC4A is below 2 V
initially powers up by default with CRC disabled
When the data length in 0x61 is read, the device automatically increments
data length must be\s+written last, after the checksum has been written

trm_text_checks.fact: RAW FULLSCAN is a pulse, not latched

trm_text_checks.regex: 2\s+INITCOMP\s+This bit is latched when the device completes the startup measurement sequence

trm_text_checks.fact: DSG route bit order 7..0 differs from Enabled A, table 12-12
CHG route bit order 7..0 differs from DSG and Enabled A, table 12-13
Both route bit order 7..0 has no OTINT, table 12-14
Safety Status B bit order 7..0 differs from Enabled B, table 11-4

source_conflicts: SLUUCI8 section 5.1.2 prose contains stale Cell1/upper-cell addresses. Tables 5-1 and 11-1 and SLUAAM4 section 1.2 establish 0x14 / physical Cell5 at 0x1C.
SLUAAM4 section 3.4 summary labels Vcell Mode H2. SLUUCI8 table 12-6 and address summary establish H1 at 0x901B; 0x901C is a different setting.

REGOUT default summary 0x08 and the voltage-field prose default disagree. Driver uses actual live and DM readback, refuses mismatch before EXIT_CFGUPDATE, and never overwrites REGOUT voltage or address.
